source.title: Memory integration: neural mechanisms and implications for behavior.

confidence_rationale: Directly on the integrate-vs-separate axis MECH-391's allocation gate steers: related memories interconnect via overlapping neuronal populations; mPFC schema representations guide reactivation that promotes hippocampal integration (schema_fit input). High mapping fidelity for the 'integrate' pole; the explicit DECISION policy (when to integrate vs separate, and pricing false-linking) remains the novel REE overlay.
failure_signatures: The paper documents integration as a mechanism but does not specify WHEN integration should be withheld; it evidences only the integrate pole, so it cannot ground the cost of OVER-integration (false linking) that INV-079 and the allocation policy must price -- a one-sided grounding that, taken alone, would bias the gate toward linking.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Related memories become interconnected through recruitment of overlapping neuronal populations; a hippocampal-medial-prefrontal circuit supports integration, with abstracted mPFC representations guiding reactivation of related memories during new encoding so related experiences become linked, supporting flexible generalisation.
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds the 'integrate' decision of MECH-391's allocation gate and the schema_fit input: the substrate by which a new experience is linked to related prior traces (overlapping populations, mPFC-guided reactivation) is exactly the actuator the allocation policy would steer when it chooses integrate over separate.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This grounds the integrate POLE and its substrate, not the DECISION POLICY. It says nothing about when to choose separate, and -- crucially -- it evidences only the benefit of linking, not the cost of false linking (the one-sided-lit caveat already flagged for INV-079 via Sahay 2011). The context_similarity x temporal_distance interaction and the false-linking price remain ungrounded here.
mapping.source_context: Review of human cognitive/behavioural neuroscience of memory integration (fMRI, behaviour).

confidence_components.notes: Highest mapping fidelity in this set for the allocation-gate's integrate pole; honest about grounding only one side.
